definitions.gloss: to skip out on, ditch, bail on
definitions.explanation: To fail to show up for or abandon an obligation, often without notice or explanation.
To pretend not to know about something, especially to avoid responsibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧バックレた。
examples.english: I skipped out on my part-time job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧バックレて⟦{遊|あそ}び→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I ditched class and went to hang out.

⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧バックレたら⟦{怒|おこ}られた→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。

notes:
バックレる is youth slang derived from {白|しら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to play innocent) or ⟦バック→バック：12378_bakku⟧れる (from "back" + verb ending). It's conjugated as a godan verb: バックレる、バックレない、バックレた.

This word has a negative connotation and implies irresponsibility. It's very casual and should not be used in formal situations.

Common collocations:
- ⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧バックレる: skip out on a part-time job
- ⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧バックレる: ditch class
- ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧バックレる: bail on plans
